```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(mclust)
library(khroma)
```


```{r load se}
if (!exists('t2t_clean_se')) {
    t2t_clean_se <- readRDS(here('t2t_clean_se.rds'))
} 
```


```{r make dds}
if (!exists('t2t_dds')) {
t2t_dds <- DESeqDataSet(t2t_clean_se, ~ Karyotype)
t2t_dds <- estimateSizeFactors(t2t_dds)
t2t_keep <- rowSums(counts(t2t_dds) >= 10) >= 3
t2t_dds <- t2t_dds[t2t_keep,]
}

assays(t2t_dds)$vst_Karyotype <- vst(t2t_dds) %>% assay()
```


```{r XIST expr}
XIST_expr <- 
  t2t_dds[mcols(t2t_dds)$gene_name == 'XIST',] %>%
  counts(normalized = TRUE) %>% #Mclust(XIST_counts) %>%#'Mclust' model object: (V,3) # Best model has 3 clusters #  .$BIC #3 -1661.957 -1187.364
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column('names') %>%
  mutate(XISTcounts = V1, .keep = 'unused') %>%
  left_join(
    colData(t2t_dds) %>% as.data.frame(),
    by = 'names'
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    t2t_dds[mcols(t2t_dds)$gene_name == 'XIST',] %>% 
      assays() %>% 
      .$vst_Karyotype %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
      rownames_to_column('names') %>%
      mutate(XISTvst = V1, .keep = 'unused')
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    XISTcluster = Mclust(.$XISTvst) %>% .$classification %>% as.factor(),
    XISTbimodal = Mclust(.$XISTvst, G = 2) %>% .$classification %>% as.factor(),
    XISTexclude = case_when(XCD > 1 & XISTbimodal == 1 ~ 'excluded', TRUE ~ 'included')
  )

```


```{r}
XIST_expr %>%
  ggplot(aes(XCD, log2(XISTcounts + 1), fill = fct_reorder(Karyotype, XCD), shape = XISTcluster, alpha = XISTexclude)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, stroke = 0.15) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c('1'= 25, '2' = 23, '3' = 24)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c('excluded'= 0.5 , 'included' = 0.85)) +
  scale_fill_discrete(palette = khroma::color('muted', reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 1.5))) +
  labs(
    y = 'XIST expression (log2 counts)',
    fill = 'Karyotype'
  )


```


```{r}
t2t_XISTclean_se <- 
  t2t_clean_se[,t2t_clean_se$names %in% dplyr::filter(XIST_expr, XISTexclude == 'included')$names]

saveRDS(t2t_XISTclean_se, 't2t_XISTclean_se.rds')
```

cleanest comparability with dream/limma: Use the voom scale you already have:
x <- vobj$E[gene, ] (logCPM with the voom 0.5 offset)
Then run Mclust on x.

If you want a DESeq2-native transform for ML/clustering: Use VST with blind=FALSE (given strong group differences / structural zeros)
Then run Mclust.

are 'XN > 2 ' one or two clusters? YES

```{r}
  
poly2_wald_dds[mcols(poly2_wald_dds)$gene_symbol == 'XIST',] %>%
 assays() %>% 
 .$XYscaled_vst %>% t() %>%
 as.data.frame() %>%
 rownames_to_column('names') %>%
  full_join(
    colData(poly2_wald_dds) %>% as.data.frame(),
    by = 'names'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Xn == 3 | Xn == 4) %>%
  pull(ENSG00000229807.13) %>%
  Mclust() %>%
  .$BIC
  
```


is 'XN2 high part of the same cluster? yes

```{r}
poly2_wald_dds[mcols(poly2_wald_dds)$gene_symbol == 'XIST',] %>%
 assays() %>% 
 .$XYscaled_vst %>% t() %>%
 as.data.frame() %>%
 rownames_to_column('names') %>%
  full_join(
    colData(poly2_wald_dds) %>% as.data.frame(),
    by = 'names'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ENSG00000229807.13 > 7.5) %>%
  pull(ENSG00000229807.13) %>%
  Mclust() %>%
  .$BIC
```
